SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE & S. B. REGISTRY
File No. D 4775
SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE. N. D
S. 2. Special Branch
REPORT
Date April 26, 1933.
Subject (in full) Enquiry regarding Doria Ivanoff alias Mary Ivanoff.
Made by D.S.I. Everest. Forwarded by J.B.M. O.
With reference to the attached memo from the
Officer i/c Special Branch regarding Mary Ivanoff, I have
to report the following :-
Doria Ivanoff alias Mary Ivanoff, Russian, age
45, is the wife of a Chinese named Toi Fou Yu (代富玉),
age 45/50, native of Shantung, to whom she has been married
for a number of years. Toi Fou Yu and his wife arrived
in Shanghai from Harbin about three years ago. They have
resided at their present address, 143/5 Route Pere Robert,
since March 15, 1933. Information has been obtained from
the French Police that at different times during the past
year or two Toi Fou Yu and his wife operated small restaurants
of a doubtful character at 79 Route de Soeurs and 166 Route
Vallon.
No. 143/5 Route Pere Robert is a Russian boarding
house tenanted by a number of Russian women of the demi-monde
type and there is reason to suspect that Doria Ivanoff is
a procuress.
JR
D.S.I. Everest
D. S. I.
Officer i/c Special Branch.

报告
日期：1933年4月26日。
主题（全称）：关于多丽娅·伊万诺夫，又名玛丽·伊万诺夫的调查。
由警司埃弗勒斯制作。由 J.B.M. O. 转呈。
兹参照附上的特别处主管关于玛丽·伊万诺夫的备忘录，本人须报告如下情况：
多丽娅·伊万诺夫，又名玛丽·伊万诺夫，俄国人，年龄45岁，系一名叫代富玉（Toi Fou Yu）的中国人的妻子，该中国人年龄45至50岁，山东籍，她已与其结婚多年。代富玉及其妻子约于三年前从哈尔滨抵达上海。自1933年3月15日以来，他们一直居住在现址拉神父路143/5号。从法租界巡捕房获得的情报显示，在过去的一两年里，代富玉及其妻子曾在修女路79号和瓦隆路166号经营性质可疑的小型餐馆。
拉神父路143/5号是一家俄国寄宿公寓，租客为多名半妓女性质的俄国妇女，有理由怀疑多丽娅·伊万诺夫是一名鸨母。
JR
警司 埃弗勒斯
警司
特别处主管。

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE
C. & S. B. REGISTRY.
Memorandum No. 4795
POLICE FORCE,
MUNICIPAL COUNCIL
Shanghai, 22 . 4 . 1933
To S.2,

Please endeavour to
ascertain some particulars
regarding
Miss Mary Ivanoff,
No. 145 Route
Pere Robert, who
sometimes entertains
British soldiers there.
It is thought that
Miss Ivanoff may be
endeavouring to put the
soldiers into touch with
Red agents.
D.S.I. Everest. S.B.R 24/4

备忘录编号 4795
警察部队，
工部局
上海，1933年4月22日
致 S.2，

请设法查明
居住在拉神父路145号的
玛丽·伊万诺夫小姐的一些具体情况，
她有时在那里
招待英国士兵。
据认为，
伊万诺夫小姐可能正
试图让士兵们
与红色代理人取得联系。
警司 埃弗勒斯。特别处登记室 4月24日
